title: dianthus caryophyllus f. charmelii
intro: Dianthus caryophyllus f. charmelii, commonly known as pink carnation, is a fragrant and ornamental plant species within the carnation family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin irritations, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus caryophyllus f. charmelii include calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
